items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And Jack Walker and I -- I'm going to (inaudible) tell him something and it sound good to him, he say, "Yeah, I think I'll try that out."

ctx.x: Say, "I wanna bring Joe Loco. You know, the Latin people would come (inaudible) to the Apollo."
At that time, I had told Jack Walker on WLIB -- I say, "Look, why don't you -- these Latin guys I'm booking -- Tito Puente, Tito Rodriguez," because those guys are popular.
